name: forest-plan
summary: The PR chain becomes a forest
body: planStack now reads the hard deps: weakly connected components submit in parallel, a change bases on its single dependency (a tree of PRs), and a component holding a diamond degrades to a chain in landing order. The executor pushes ism-slice mirrors instead of stack shas, so every PR carries only its own component’s history. Soft (semantic) deps are not yet part of the forest computation — a known limitation recorded in the design log.
